Question Choices: Select. Which is greater A. 7 x 6 B. 9 x 5 ~~A | B~~
Hints: Solve each multiplication separately. What is 7 x 6? Then what is 9 x 5?
Solution: A is 7 x 6 = 42. B is 9 x 5 = 45. Since 45 is greater than 42, select B.

Question Choices: If 10 x 4 = 40. How many more is that than 7 x 4?
Solution: Ten groups of 4 give 40 and seven groups give 28. Subtract: 40-28 = 12 more.

Question Choices: The party has 40 guests. They are sitting at 8 tables. Each table has the same number of guests. How many guests per table?
Hints: 8 equal groups that together make 40, what is the group size?
Solution: Share 40 guests equally among 8 tables: 40 divided by 8 = 5 guests per table. Check: 8 x 5 = 40.

Question Choices: Select. Class X has 4 groups with total 20 kids. Class Y has 5 groups with total 20 kids. Which class has larger group size? ~~A | B~~
Hints: Find each group size: Class X has 20 divided by 4; Class Y has 20 divided by 5.
Solution: Class X has 20 divided by 4 = 5 children per group. Class Y has 20 divided by 5 = 4 per group. Five is greater than four, so select A (Class X).
